summary: First run with 64 envs (10k episodes, seed=0, buffer=100k). Grasp reached 100% faster (step 4003 vs 6015 in prior run). grow_plants reached 9.4% — first time any grow goal showed meaningful progress. LP estimates are now persistently nonzero (0.018-0.019 range) — the switch to 64 envs provided enough replay diversity for the SR head to learn. No entropy NaN.

findings.description: Reached 90%+ at step 2004, 100% at step 4003. Faster than 86722adf (step 6015) — 64 envs provides richer trajectories per update.
Reached 9.4% (first nonzero crossing >=5% at step 9002). First evidence of grow_plants learning. Max 9.4% — not enough episodes to push further.
findings.recommendation: Extend to 40k episodes to see if grow_plants continues improving. Confirmed in b5452f4a (reaches 100%).

findings.description: LP estimates are persistently nonzero at end (~0.018-0.020 for all goal types). The 64-env change unlocked LP signal that was absent at 32 envs. All types have similar LP — suggests SR head is detecting some learning potential across the board.
Finite, rose from 0.091 to 1.49. Value loss 0.0017 — well converged. No issues.

comparison: vs. 86722adf: switching from 32→64 envs unlocked LP signal (0.0→0.019) and grow_plants started learning (0%→9.4%). Grasp also faster (6015→4003). The 64-env change is the key config difference.
